methods.principle: Separate source-neutral preparation from target glyphs and speech
methods.when: Same source with multiple locales or small visual refinements
methods.action: Verify source and asset hashes, reuse clean master/music/geometry, rebuild only locale/copy-dependent glyphs and speech
methods.done: Each asset has source, locale/copy scope and input/output hashes; every actual final locale is checked
methods.failure_signature: Old-language glyphs or full narration leak into another language

methods.principle: Remove text over its full animated extent
methods.when: Text pops in, zooms or is clipped by the frame
methods.action: Inspect first/last visible frames at source fps; include glyph interiors, outline, shifted backing and shadow; review neutral plate before adding target
methods.done: Actual final continuous frames show no source lettering; OCR is supporting evidence
methods.failure_signature: Static bbox misses a one-frame enlargement; open blue contour leaves a clipped W

methods.principle: Rebuild artistic lettering as shape, fill, outline, depth and motion
methods.when: Source uses decorative rather than ordinary UI lettering
methods.action: Choose a legible target font, sample source texture when feasible, separate stroke widths/colors and offset layers, follow measured motion and retain a frame-safe target footprint
methods.done: Actual source/final comparisons assess glyph readability, texture scale, edge proportions, position, timing and foreground occlusion
methods.failure_signature: Plain red letters mimic colors but omit texture/offset; a concentric ring replaces a directional shadow

methods.principle: Verify protected objects in the composite
methods.when: Dropdown icons, foreground photos, emoji or arrows touch translated text
methods.action: Inspect both neutral pixels and alpha masks; keep original objects, exclude background branches from foreground protection, correct only the implicated layer
methods.done: No icon collision, bright fill contamination, damaged object edge or glyph cutout on actual encoded output
methods.failure_signature: Inpainting drags white icon color into text; protection contour absorbs dark background and cuts into a glyph

methods.principle: Bind user-approved audio to actual soundtrack identity
methods.when: User approves audio and a later edit changes only visuals
methods.action: Save direct approval, locale, video and soundtrack hash; verify identical audio on reuse and preserve its meaning/timing. Resolve recognizer uncertainty with stronger evidence before unnecessary re-dubbing
methods.done: New output soundtrack equals approved one, or changed speech has fresh checks; user acceptance and technical objective checks are separately attributed
methods.failure_signature: A noisy/homophonic ASR transcript overrides a confirmed listening result or is presented as proof of lossless music

limits: One source family; cross-source defaults not enabled
Clean frame476 works for the frozen-photo CTA, not arbitrary moving backgrounds
Source HSV thresholds and font/texture dimensions are example-specific
Original font recovery and arbitrary brush/3D lettering are not demonstrated
User-approved sound is not a new stem-level lossless measurement
next_falsification: On another authorized source, separately test a moving-background CTA and an object touching the text. Re-measure masks, font coverage and motion; record actual final frames, sound and cost before broad promotion.
promotion: Generalized methods remain candidate; source-scoped approved sample and verified assets are the active entries
